Summary: The FRED calendar lists economic data releases for each day, including the time of release. On October 16, 2026, releases include the Euro Short Term Rate at 1:00 am, Harmonized Indices of Consumer Prices (HICP) at 5:00 am, and SOFR Averages and Index Data at 7:00 am, among others. The calendar is part of the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) service, which provides access to a wide range of U.S. economic time series data.

   URL: https://fredblog.stlouisfed.org/2022/12/another-year-another-fred-data-calendar
   FRED maintains an Economic Release Calendar for each day of the year, detailing the data releases published on that date and, if known, also the time of the release. A green checkmark indicates a release has been updated in FRED.
